newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gen des Eaux up after brokers' meeting.
newsitem.headline: Gen des Eaux up after brokers' meeting.

text.p: Shares in Generale des Eaux rose sharply on Friday after a breakfast meeting between chairman Jean-Louis Messier and portfolio managers during which Messier was bullish about the company.
The share was up 2.65 percent at 620 francs at 1240 GMT.

A manager who attended the meeting organised by brokerage Chevreux de Virieu said Messier relayed "a very confident message" and confirmed recent profit forecasts, suggesting there may be a positive surprise.
Messier said on October 14 that 1997 results would be sharply above 1996 results, estimated at around 1.8 billion francs.
The manager said he also left the meeting with the impression that there would be no capital increase.
Generale des Eaux officials were not immediately available for comment.
